capabilities: Create and edit draw.io diagrams fully offline
Link note links and external links to diagram shapes
Embed markdown fragments inside diagram shapes
Use diagrams in Canvas with links and fragments
Render Mermaid and LaTeX inside diagrams
extras: Interactive features (shape links, markdown fragments) currently work only in reading mode. After installing the plugin, users must download the draw.io client from the plugin settings. Runs a local web server on the user's machine.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in tool for creating and editing diagrams beyond limited Mermaid code blocks.

relations.evidence: This plugin launches a local web server that serves the Draw.io web app directly from your machine.

summary: Diagram editor that embeds the draw.io (diagrams.net) web app locally, letting users create and edit offline diagrams stored as .drawio.svg files.
